Unai Emery watches 12 hours so his players do not have to

Unai Emery won his fifth Europa League title in 2026 with Aston Villa. But calling him a cup specialist misses the more useful point. He has said he may spend 12 hours analysing one match, then has to compress what he sees into roughly one hour that players can understand. 相手を観察し、情報を圧縮し、練習で反復し、試合中に更新する。His real system may be less a formation than a repeatable learning loop.
